_comment: Octail's own egg (pelican-eggs' games-steamcmd assetto_corsa egg was read as a reference only). App 302550 is not available to anonymous SteamCMD logins, so the egg uses Octail's steam_login feature (required): the Steam account picked on the Startup tab logs in, Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console and the login is cached for start-time updates. The Windows depot is downloaded (it carries the Linux acServer), SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times, and the install fails when acServer is missing. cfg/server_cfg.ini is edited with the ini parser before every start (name, passwords, ports, cars, track, slots, lobby), cfg/entry_list.ini is written from the cars and slots before every start unless the entry list is set to manual. The HTTP port gets a port of its own (port_vars). acServer reads no console input and stops on Ctrl+C; the start is its start line or the TCP game port once bound. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Assetto Corsa
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Kunos Simulazioni's Assetto Corsa racing simulator: the official dedicated server (acServer) from SteamCMD. Needs a Steam account that owns Assetto Corsa.
startup:
if [ "${ENTRY_LIST}" = auto ]; then case "${MAX_CLIENTS}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo 'Max players must be a number.'; exit 1;; esac; IFS=";" read -ra octail_cars <<< "${CARS}"; octail_n=0; while [ "$octail_n" -lt "${MAX_CLIENTS}" ]; do printf '[CAR_%d]
MODEL=%s
SKIN=
SPECTATOR_MODE=0
DRIVERNAME=
TEAM=
GUID=
BALLAST=0
RESTRICTOR=0

' "$octail_n" "${octail_cars[octail_n % ${#octail_cars[@]}]}"; octail_n=$((octail_n + 1)); done > cfg/entry_list.ini; fi; exec ./acServer

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Assetto Corsa dedicated server (Octail's own install script; pelican-eggs' egg was read as a reference only).
# App 302550 can't be downloaded anonymously: the server needs a Steam account (Octail's steam_login feature fills
# STEAM_USER and, for this install only, STEAM_PASS; Steam Guard codes are asked for in the console).
set -uo pipefail

if [ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" ] || [ "${STEAM_USER}" = anonymous ]; then
    echo "The Assetto Corsa server can't be downloaded anonymously: pick a Steam account on the Startup tab"
    echo "(Steam account), then reinstall the server."
    exit 1
fi
echo "Logging in to Steam as ${STEAM_USER}"

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || exit 1
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing

## the account's saved login (Tentacle's login cache), so later updates log in without the password
if [ -n "${STEAM_LOGIN_CACHE:-}" ]; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/steamcmd/config && ln -s "${STEAM_LOGIN_CACHE}" /mnt/server/steamcmd/config
fi
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
export HOME=/mnt/server

LOGIN=("${STEAM_USER}")
[ -n "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ] && LOGIN+=("${STEAM_PASS}")
[ -n "${STEAM_AUTH:-}" ] && LOGIN+=("${STEAM_AUTH}")

## install the server with steamcmd: the Windows depot carries the Linux acServer too
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +login "${LOGIN[@]}" +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/acServer" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Assetto Corsa dedicated server. The Steam account must own Assetto Corsa;"
    echo "check the login lines above, then reinstall."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/acServer

mkdir -p /mnt/server/cfg
cd /mnt/server/cfg
if [ ! -f server_cfg.ini ]; then
    echo "No cfg/server_cfg.ini in the download: writing a default one (practice, pickup mode)."
    cat > server_cfg.ini <<'OCTAIL_EOF'
[SERVER]
NAME=Assetto Corsa server
CARS=abarth500
CONFIG_TRACK=
TRACK=magione
SUN_ANGLE=48
PASSWORD=
ADMIN_PASSWORD=
UDP_PORT=9600
TCP_PORT=9600
HTTP_PORT=8081
MAX_BALLAST_KG=0
QUALIFY_MAX_WAIT_PERC=120
RACE_PIT_WINDOW_START=0
RACE_PIT_WINDOW_END=0
REVERSED_GRID_RACE_POSITIONS=0
LOCKED_ENTRY_LIST=0
PICKUP_MODE_ENABLED=1
LOOP_MODE=1
SLEEP_TIME=1
CLIENT_SEND_INTERVAL_HZ=18
SEND_BUFFER_SIZE=0
RECV_BUFFER_SIZE=0
RACE_OVER_TIME=180
KICK_QUORUM=85
VOTING_QUORUM=80
VOTE_DURATION=20
BLACKLIST_MODE=1
FUEL_RATE=100
DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER=100
TYRE_WEAR_RATE=100
ALLOWED_TYRES_OUT=2
ABS_ALLOWED=1
TC_ALLOWED=1
STABILITY_ALLOWED=0
AUTOCLUTCH_ALLOWED=1
TYRE_BLANKETS_ALLOWED=1
FORCE_VIRTUAL_MIRROR=0
START_RULE=0
RACE_GAS_PENALTY_DISABLED=0
TIME_OF_DAY_MULT=1
RESULT_SCREEN_TIME=60
MAX_CONTACTS_PER_KM=-1
REGISTER_TO_LOBBY=1
MAX_CLIENTS=10
NUM_THREADS=2
UDP_PLUGIN_LOCAL_PORT=0
UDP_PLUGIN_ADDRESS=
AUTH_PLUGIN_ADDRESS=
LEGAL_TYRES=
WELCOME_MESSAGE=

[PRACTICE]
NAME=Practice
TIME=60
IS_OPEN=1

[DYNAMIC_TRACK]
SESSION_START=95
RANDOMNESS=2
SESSION_TRANSFER=90
LAP_GAIN=10

[WEATHER_0]
GRAPHICS=3_clear
BASE_TEMPERATURE_AMBIENT=20
BASE_TEMPERATURE_ROAD=7
VARIATION_AMBIENT=1
VARIATION_ROAD=1
OCTAIL_EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD (the saved login of the server's Steam account) before every start.

variables.name: Windows depot
variables.description: Updates fetch the Windows depot, which carries the Linux acServer.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server list (up to 64 characters, no ; or #).

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Players need it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Typed in the game's chat as /admin <password> to kick, ban and change sessions. 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-.

variables.name: Cars
variables.description: Car folder names (content/cars), separated by ; (for example ks_mazda_miata;ks_toyota_gt86).

variables.name: Track
variables.description: The track's folder name (content/tracks), for example magione or ks_vallelunga.

variables.name: Track layout
variables.description: The layout folder for tracks with several (ks_vallelunga: club_circuit, classic_circuit, extended_circuit); empty for tracks with one.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Slots; no more than the track has pit boxes.

variables.name: Entry list
variables.description: auto: cfg/entry_list.ini is written before every start with one slot per player, the cars taking turns; manual: the file is left as you edit it.

variables.name: Show in the lobby
variables.description: 1 lists the server in the game's server browser, 0 only allows joining by address.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: The server's HTTP port (TCP), used by the lobby and the game's server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).
